spec.name: pipeline-3805
spec.description: Reduce incremental identity-verification row transport cost while preserving both complete integrity checks.
constraints: Keep every per-table identity row and all corruption checks at both existing publication boundaries.
No persistent caches, dependencies, native upgrades, FTS skips or reduced indexed content.
Fail closed for malformed batch responses. Preserve null, Unicode, duplicate and missing identity handling.
Pin runtimes/corpora; complete all paired samples; compare semantic hashes and persisted call targets.
Sparse-corpus selection is not a production/full-repository claim. No holdout configured.
Require three independent paired sessions, warm improvement >5%, fresh regression <=3%; inspect peak RSS and larger-table memory.
Run targeted/native integrity tests, typechecks, full npm test and graph change analysis before a keep commit.
